<b>Elder Pilgrims</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are older pilgrims consumed by the [[Haunting]] who use their solid frame to crush others.<ref>Elder Pilgrim [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Thick-set bug consumed by haunted thread. Uses their solid frame to crush others. A lucky bug to be able to grow old."</i></ref> They are incredibly rare, with most appearances either being one-time events or RNG-based.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Elder Pilgrims naturally wander around slowly, pausing on occasion.<br>
Once they detect [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], they jump into the air above where she was first detected, hover for a brief moment, and then slam themselves directly down to the ground to deal contact damage.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Elder Pilgrims have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Elder Pilgrims have a 1/3 chance of spawning on the left side of the entrance to [[Chapel of the Wanderer]] in [[Bone Bottom]] during [[Acts|Acts 1 and 2]], and a 2/3 chance during [[Act 3]].

After acquiring [[Cling Grip]], a unique non-respawning Elder Pilgrim can be found in a small room near the top of [[the Marrow]].

In Act 3, they can always be found in [[Lumble the Lucky|Lumble the Lucky's]] room at the [[Blasted Steps]], up until the [[Lost Garmond]] fight.<br>
There is also a chance for one of them to be fighting [[Shakra]] outside the [[Shellwood]] exit of [[Bellhart]], or outside the [[Greymoor]] exit.
